name: Dots Studio
description: Dots Studio is the model team behind the Dots family, developed and released by Xiaohongshu (RedNote).

sources.notes: The official model card identifies Dots Studio as the developer and release team and states that the model is developed by Xiaohongshu.

verification.notes: Organisation identity and model ownership are supported by the official model card; the country code follows Xiaohongshu's China-based ownership.
